caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a bonnet, rendered primarily in pencil or graphite on a plain, off-white background. The bonnet covers the head and is detailed with a pattern of small, closely spaced circular and oval shapes, indicating a textured or lace-like fabric. The edge of the bonnet features a ruffled or scalloped trim, and there is a ribbon or tie extending from the lower edge, tied into a loose bow. The shading and line work vary to suggest the contours and folds of the fabric, and the entire object is oriented in profile, with the opening of the bonnet facing to the right. There are no additional objects or elements present in the composition.
title: Bonnet
